title: `, ~, ! and @
intro: Keys this course has not used yet: `, ~, ! and @. Some need Shift, held by the little finger of the other hand; the rest sit on a key the course has not used before.
congrats: `, ~, ! and @: under your fingers now. Shift with the other hand, and a symbol comes as easily as the letter beside it.

screens.text: ` belongs to your left little finger.
` on its own first, then where it is actually used.
~ on its own first, then where it is actually used.
! belongs to your left little finger, with Shift held by the other hand.
